CAPABILITY_MANIFEST.description: Pure, stateless verification of the three signed expected-action artifacts against a resolved node identity key, with the wallet-libsodium Ed25519/SHA-256 crypto dependency-injected by the caller.
Pure predicate binding an implementer's independently-established node identity pin to a resolved key, defeating the compromised-platform substitution scenario.

Any-depth landed-operation proof manifests. Reserved capability category only — landing-proof is not an instruction-origin dependency and has not merged onto this freeze base; no interface is fabricated here.

SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.scenario: a compromised platform substitutes a different, otherwise-valid instruction on a platform-hosted page
SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.rationale: Platform-controlled code controls both what is shown and the check itself; a valid node artifact alone never proves the presented instruction is genuine (R-07).

SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.scenario: same substitution attempt on a platform-hosted page that ALSO performs its own pin check
SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.rationale: platform-hosted is frozen non-substitution-proof unconditionally: the platform still controls the pin check itself, so a pin check IT performs proves nothing about independence.

SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.scenario: instruction presented on a node-controlled origin with an independently verified pin
SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.rationale: An origin the platform cannot silently alter, plus a key check against a pin established outside the platform's control, defeats the substitution.

SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.scenario: instruction presented on an implementer-controlled origin with an independently verified pin
SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.rationale: Same defense as node-origin: an origin the platform cannot alter, plus an independent pin check.

SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.scenario: node-controlled origin, but the pin was never independently verified
SUBSTITUTION_THREAT_TABLE.rationale: Origin control alone is insufficient; without a verified pin a substituted key is undetectable.
